static_barrier_diagnostics.interpretation: Advisory possible paths, not proof of deadlock or safety. Matching expressions across functions require the same runtime object and concurrent barrier participants.
limitations: Direct pthread calls only; no interprocedural or pointer-alias analysis.

Unsupported control flow and nested/indirect calls are reported as coverage gaps.
